instruction: Extract all paper titles from 'references.docx' on the Desktop and save them in a file named 'simple_bibliography.txt' on the Desktop, using any straightforward format.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a simple bibliography from 6 papers in references.docx. Evaluator reads both source (references.docx) and output (simple_bibliography.txt) files to verify correctness. Uses flexible heuristics to count paper entries supporting multiple formats (numbered lists, bullet points, capitalized lines, or plain text). Cross-references source papers with output using fuzzy word matching (60% word overlap threshold) to ensure correct papers are included, not just any 6 entries.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.6 for content correctness (proportion of source papers matched in output using fuzzy matching), 0.2 for having at least 6 paper-like entries in output, 0.2 for having at least 6 total lines
